verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It establishes the conjugacy-class size formula via a bijection with left cosets of the centralizer, shows every noncentral conjugacy class has size divisible by p, and applies the class equation to deduce that p divides |Z(G)|. Since the identity lies in the center and p is at least 2, the center contains a nonidentity element. The statement is self-contained, all hypotheses are used, and there are no external-paper or fact_id citations requiring validation.
